policy: These are hypotheses with an explicit gate ledger. A strategy is promoted to the leaderboard only when every blocking gate is recorded as passed on later, untouched data. No strategy is claimed to be profitable.

gates.rule: Rule, inputs and staking written to the repo before any graded result.
At least 200 graded bets per strategy before any skill claim.
Fit on past weeks, grade on later weeks. No same-game fitting.
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across all tested strategies.
Must beat the vig-free closing line or a no-bet baseline, not a guess.
95% CI on ROI and on hit rate must exclude the break-even rate.
Deflated Sharpe: reward adjusted for number of trials run.
Parlay legs must show a measured joint distribution, not multiplied marginals.
Every input row carries an official source URL and a fetch date.
Inputs must be published before the decision cutoff for that game.

leaderboard_rule.eligibility: all blocking gates passed, minimum 200 graded bets, pre-registered
leaderboard_rule.score: vig-free ROI with a 95% CI, tie-broken by deflated Sharpe
leaderboard_rule.rewards: notional only: the leaderboard ranks strategies, it does not pay money. Any real reward needs a decision recorded on the Suggestions page.
anti_gaming: results posted with the losing bets
one submission per strategy family per week

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted net rating difference
strategies.construction: Full-game side. Difference of net ratings from model.json at the decision cutoff.
strategies.status: hypothesis - cannot pass without a market price series

strategies.name: Home-field measured vs assumed
strategies.construction: Side only when measured home-field differs from the market's implied home-field.

strategies.name: Pythagorean luck fade
strategies.construction: Fade clubs whose wins exceed Pythagorean expectation by more than 1.5 wins.
strategies.status: hypothesis - needs market prices to grade

strategies.name: Starter-out deficiency signal
strategies.construction: Side against a club starting a 2nd-or-deeper string at QB/LT/CB1/EDGE1.
strategies.inputs: official injury report + club depth chart
strategies.status: hypothesis - depth charts are club-published and mostly unofficial

strategies.name: Backup-promotion fade (offense)
strategies.construction: Under on the side whose offensive line or QB depth is degraded.

strategies.name: Total vs margin joint filter
strategies.construction: Only combine a total leg with a side leg when the measured total/margin correlation for that game archetype is below the policy threshold.
strategies.status: hypothesis - current sample is too small to certify any leg pair

strategies.name: Two-side arb of correlated scores
strategies.construction: Two teams' scores co-move negatively; exploit only with a measured joint model.
strategies.status: hypothesis - sign of the measured correlation must clear its CI first

strategies.name: Player prop combo (same game)
strategies.construction: Combine player props whose measured joint distribution beats the product of their marginals by more than the price.
strategies.status: blocked - no player-prop history and no official prop source

strategies.name: Injury-news timing edge
strategies.construction: Act on the first official injury-report posting before the line settles.
strategies.inputs: official injury report timestamps + line timestamps

strategies.name: Rest and short-week differential
strategies.construction: Side with the rest advantage measured in days, net of travel.
strategies.status: hypothesis - travel distance not yet ingested from an official source

graded_results.why: grading requires market prices, which no official source publishes
